shortDescription: HIP-3 market deployer Entropy has launched an Anthropic pre-IPO market on Hyperliquid. According to Odaily, ANTH is up 0.76% over the past 24 hours and is trading at $2,139, with 24-hour trading volume of $9.18 million and open interest of $28.95 million.
